node.title: ext_pole_floor covers e-interleaved base-list witnesses (the S9 seam)
node.statement: REFINED (Pro round 3, verified): the interleaved list-counting is EXACT — the e-interleaved witness has effective size L_eff = #{(A_1..A_e): |cap A_i| >= a} = the ordinary EXTENSION-CODE list size |Lambda(C_E, 1-a/n, f+zg)| (L2 bridge), NOT L^e; interleaving filters the product by common support. The pole floor then applies with N_int(L_eff) = ceil(L_eff X /(X + kappa_int L_eff)). SOLE remaining seam: ExtPoleFloorAppliesToWeilRestrictedInterleaving — the Paper D floor PROOF is functorial under Weil restriction (accepts a B-defined Weil-restricted interleaved witness as a base list). FOR THE GEOMETRIC EXCLUSION (ef_pole_free_cycle_exclusion) the SINGLETON suffices: L_eff=1 => N_int(1)=ceil(X/(X+kappa))=1 (VERIFIED, all X>0) => component meets D_E. So ef exclusion closes modulo the singleton functoriality; only the numerator LEDGER needs the full L_eff gate.
